body:
ISSUE: #8831
GOAL: dead-letter this non-actionable complaint intake so it stops competing with scoped, verifiable backlog work.
VERIFY: issue state changes from OPEN to CLOSED and this comment records the dead-letter routing with a raw-evidence chain.
TARGET-LANE: dead_letter
REASON: the issue contains only a generic complaint (title + one-line body) with no reproducible bug, requested feature boundary, environment-specific failure, or acceptance criteria, so leaving it open creates lane drift without an atomic verify gate.

ACTION: dead_letter
RAW-EVIDENCE-CHAIN:
- before.issue.state=OPEN
- before.issue.title="我感觉并没有学习也没有提升到"
- before.issue.body="不是说是学习的框架吗？怎么那么烂的？？"
- before.issue.comments=0
- action.dead_letter=close issue as not planned and remove it from active execution routing
- after.expected.state=CLOSED
- after.expected.routing=non-actionable intake only

RESULT: Marking #8831 as non-actionable intake. Do not route implementation, debugging, or release work through this issue. If there is a real defect or feature request, re-file it as a new scoped issue with reproduction or acceptance criteria.

<!-- hermes-sweeper:item=8831 -->
<!-- hermes-sweeper:verdict=close reason=incoherent confidence=high -->
Thanks for filing — automated hermes-sweeper review.

This issue doesn't contain enough detail to act on. A general complaint without steps to reproduce, an expected behavior, an environment, or a specific feature name can't be triaged or routed to implementation work.

If you're experiencing a concrete problem:
- Describe what you expected to happen vs. what actually happened
- Include your Hermes version, OS, and provider
- Paste any relevant error messages or logs

Closing as incoherent. Please re-file with those details and we'll be happy to take a look.
